workspace.name: Player Equipment Magic Accuracy / Magic Resistance Contribution正規化

project_context.purpose: Player側のMagic Accuracy / Magic Resistanceを、既存Requirement係数ベース式の意味を維持したまま、物理Accuracy/Evasionと同じEquipment Candidate所有・個別Contribution合算構造へ正規化する。
project_context.summary: Fresh CurrentではMagic Accuracy/ResistanceだけがBattle RuntimeでRequirementを直接再計算している。攻撃武器ごとにmagic_accuracy、防具ごとにmagic_resistanceを生成・保存し、Player Runtimeは実装備Candidateの保存済み値だけを個別合算する。Monster側はHuman指示により今回変更しない。

current_focus.theme: GKS-B836反映済みSourceと工程管理状態の同期
current_focus.goal: Fresh Current GKS-B836の実装反映を工程管理正本へ同期し、Player側修正の完了GateをHuman確認可能な状態にする。Monster側は今回の変更対象外としてTASK-PMAG-008をBlockedで維持する。

project_rules.text: Magic AccuracyはINT/DEX、Magic ResistanceはAGI/MNDのEquipment Requirement閾値からGenerator段階でPerformance Contributionを生成し、Battle RuntimeではRequirementから再計算しない。
Magic Resistanceの4部位総量は各防具Candidateの個別Contribution合算で表現し、1防具row内へ部位数を意味する固定x4を持ち込まない。
Monster側のGeneration、連続装備相当式、Runtime、Balance Evidenceは今回変更しない。

source_baseline.source_role: Human-provided Fresh Current after GKS-B836 Player Equipment Magic Contribution update was applied
source_baseline.verification_note: Fresh Current key implementation files match the previously validated GKS-B836 applied tree byte-for-byte.

implementation_records.evidence: Verified from Fresh Current guild-adventure-studio-sub(20260901-020711).zip. package-build reports GA-B486.211 / GKS-B836. formal-contribution-resolver contains magic_accuracy/magic_resistance fields and modifier mappings; equipment-generator owns per-equipment generation; Game and Studio Player paths consume saved contributions; Monster-side semantics remain excluded. Fresh Current key implementation files match the previously validated GKS-B836 applied tree byte-for-byte.

work_boxes.title: Authority / Contract
work_boxes.body: 既存Magic Hit式、Player-only scope、Formal Equipment field追加境界を確定する。

work_boxes.title: Generator / Player Equipment Data
work_boxes.body: 各Equipment CandidateへMagic Contributionを生成・保存し、Player用Dataを新Contractへ同期する。

work_boxes.title: Player Game / Studio Runtime
work_boxes.body: Player RuntimeのRequirement直接計算を廃止し、保存済み個別Contribution合算へ切り替える。Monster側は変更しない。

work_boxes.title: Regression / Monster Non-impact
work_boxes.body: Player数値同値・Game/Studio parity・物理非回帰・Monster非変更を検証する。

tasks.title: Magic Hit AuthorityとPlayer-only境界を固定する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: RULE-SKL-MAGIC-HIT-001とHuman clarificationを照合し、Magic Accuracyは攻撃武器1件ごとに(required_int + required_dex) * 2、Magic Resistanceは防具1件ごとにrequired_agi + required_mndとすること、4防具合算で既存総量式と同値になること、Monster側を今回変更しないことを記録する。既存Authorityから一意に決まらない事項が出た場合は次Taskへ進まず停止する。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current GKS-B836 confirms the approved Player-only boundary: Magic Accuracy uses INT/DEX Requirement-derived per-weapon contribution; Magic Resistance uses AGI/MND Requirement-derived per-armor-piece contribution; Monster side remains excluded.

tasks.title: Formal Equipment Contractへmagic_accuracyとmagic_resistanceを追加する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Formal Equipment Contract、validator、schema、import/export allowlist、formal-contribution-resolverへmagic_accuracy/magic_resistanceをPerformance Contribution fieldとして追加する。MAGIC_ACCURACY/MAGIC_RESISTANCE Modifier targetを正規fieldへ接続し、Requirement fallbackを追加しない。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current assets/shared/js/formal-contribution-resolver.js contains EQUIPMENT_FIELDS magic_accuracy/magic_resistance and TARGET_TO_FIELD mappings for MAGIC_ACCURACY/MAGIC_RESISTANCE. Equipment schema/import-export paths are updated.

tasks.title: Equipment Generatorへ個別Magic Contribution生成を追加する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 攻撃武器Candidateへmagic_accuracy=(required_int+required_dex)*2、防具Candidateへmagic_resistance=required_agi+required_mndを生成・保存する。盾/矢筒の攻撃Contribution semanticsはCurrentを維持する。新しいmagic専用Balance係数は追加せず、既存Requirement閾値から生成する。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current studio/equipment/equipment-generator.js generates weapon magic_accuracy=(required_int+required_dex)*2 and armor magic_resistance=required_agi+required_mnd as candidate-owned fields.

tasks.title: Player Equipment Dataset Contractを新fieldへ同期する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Fresh Current Sourceに静的Product Equipment Masterは同梱されていないため、equipment-dataset schema / import-export / Generatorがmagic_accuracy/magic_resistanceを保持でき、Runtimeへ渡るFormal Equipment recordでfieldが欠落・破棄されないことを確認する。attack/accuracy/evasion/hp_bonus/mp_bonus等の既存fieldを変更せず、Monster専用Data/Evidenceを変更しない。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current contains no bundled static Product Equipment Master to migrate. The source-supported dataset boundary is schema/import-export/generator preservation, and those paths contain the new fields. No Monster Evidence/Data project was modified.

tasks.title: Game Player Runtimeを保存済みMagic Contribution合算へ切り替える
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Game Player RuntimeでRequirementのINT/DEX/AGI/MNDからMagic Accuracy/Resistanceを直接再計算する処理を削除し、実装備rowの保存済みmagic_accuracy/magic_resistanceを個別加算する。4防具合計に固定x4 hard-codeを残さず、Monster生成・Monster戦闘値導出は変更しない。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current game/assets/js/app-runtime.js reads normalized saved bonuses.magicAccuracy/magicResistance and equipmentBonusFromRows sums weapon magicAccuracy and armor-piece magicResistance; Requirement direct recomputation is absent from the Player equipment aggregation path.

tasks.title: Studio Player Formal Battleを保存済みMagic Contributionへ切り替える
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Studio Player Formal BattleのRequirement直接reduce式を削除し、resolved Equipment Contribution totalsからMagic Accuracy/Resistanceを取得する。Modifier適用順を維持し、Monster Formal owner/loadout経路のCurrent挙動は変更しない。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current studio/index.html Player path consumes resolved Equipment Contribution totals for Magic Accuracy/Resistance while retaining the separate Monster legacy branch, matching the Human instruction not to modify Monster-side semantics.

tasks.title: Player Magic Contribution回帰とMonster非影響Gateを実行する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: 既存総量式との数値同値、4部位個別合算、1部位差分、1部位解除、Magic Accuracy武器差分、Game/Studio Player parity、physical accuracy/evasion/hp/mp non-regression、Monster対象Source/Data非変更を確認し全件PASSする。
tasks.implementation_evidence: Fresh Current key implementation files exactly match the validated GKS-B836 applied tree. package-build=GKS-B836 / GA-B486.211 and package_manifest is consistent; prior applied validation passed Full 26/26 with no failures/warnings/timeouts.

tasks.title: Lv50 6v6全体Balance再評価をMonster修正完了まで保留する
tasks.acceptance_criteria: Player側修正後にMonster側が旧Magic Resistance構造のままである限り、Monsterを含むLv50 6v6のMagic Hit結果をBalance Authorityとして確定しない。Monster側が別案件で正規化された後にseed 7007再Evidenceへ進む。
tasks.blocking_reason: Human instruction explicitly excludes Monster-side correction from this project. A 6v6 whole-battle Magic Hit balance authority would mix corrected Player semantics with unchanged Monster semantics, so seed 7007 whole-battle re-evidence remains blocked until a separate Monster-side correction is completed.
